thread:
mia: quick sync  prototyping an auto-fallback UX that prevents flip-flop. want ops + ux + privacy input.
rahul: core ask: make oscillation visible and enforceable. add fields: max_cycles_per_hour and cool_down_ms.
leah: UI: show cycle count badge on route and a timeline with cooldown countdown. include a compact "why" pill (latency / oom / quota).
kevin: policy sketch: {mode: "auto-fallback", trigger: {type: "latency_spike", thresh_ms: 1200}, hysteresis: {min_consecutive: 3, cool_down_ms: 300000, max_cycles: 2}}. emits trigger_id.
ops-bot: Alert: auto-fallback applied to /chat at 2024-07-20T14:12:45Z (trigger_id=trg_abc123).
ux-bot: UX tweak: when cycle count == max, show locked icon and disable auto-reapply with tooltip "auto-fallback locked after 2 cycles" and quick action [Request Unlock].
privacy-bot: sampling: default first_3_non_pii with redaction=true. show shield icon for redacted samples and record redaction in audit.
leah: audit panel needs: timestamp, trigger_id, policy_snapshot_id, cycle_index, samples_link, operator_actions. operator actions are appended as immutable notes.
kevin: telemetry events: fallback_applied, fallback_locked, fallback_released each with policy_snapshot and trigger_id. store full snapshot in blob store.
mia: next steps: kevin & rahul codify policy fields; leah & ux-bot mock the cycle badge + timeline; privacy-bot confirm redaction rules. reconvene tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
